# Android 16 frozen Binder inputs

These public source inputs are pinned to immutable Android Open Source Project
commits. They are compile-time inputs only; no system library is vendored or
packaged.

* `binder_libbinder.h` — `platform/frameworks/native`
  `2827a4a16b0340ecd07c2d5a6c89991799b362bb`,
  `libs/binder/ndk/include_platform/android/binder_libbinder.h`, SHA-256
  `4a9784bac4bfb857d2f1eeed529f62c158824a598a8518fecf49d3487a175d32`.
* `IKeystoreOperation.aidl` and `keystore2-v5.hash` —
  `platform/system/hardware/interfaces`
  `f3d42be8ff32eb4ff00873bf2762d13c013d314a`,
  `keystore2/aidl/aidl_api/android.system.keystore2/5`, SHA-256 values
  `4ae85ab64c2338191eb40ecf6c97462ae78f72e3fa43c0f7bb403da111bdb66f`
  and `7e11a7f27ca72d2270a10ccd700f96b85e875b3365ebdd19338f58a0dae853e2`.

Both AOSP inputs are Apache-2.0. Regenerate NDK code only with the repository
API 36 `aidl` tool and the recorded command in Todo 9 evidence.

The project-owned `org.matrix.teesimulator.nativebridge` V2 frozen API hash is
`e2985caf1d4344e9d9f05875e68a2a774ed2d9df`. It is the Android16
`build/aidl_api.go` procedure: sorted per-file SHA-1 lines plus `2\n`, then
SHA-1 of that stream, generated by API36 build-tools `aidl`.
